correctness.rationale: At the equilibrium the characteristic factorization gives a simple pair ±i and transverse eigenvalue −b; spectral crossing is 1/(2b). Exact Hessian evaluation yields G21=5i/(b+2i), l1=5/(b²+4)>0. Nondegenerate Hopf implies a unique local repelling cycle for α<0. Direct Fourier elimination in the third equation gives R²=2(b²+4)/(5b), ω2=1/4 and T=2π(1+α/4)+O_b(α²); standalone symbolic checker and six periodic orbit shootings corroborate, not replace, the analytic proof.
